data.interpolatedContentEn: LEGAL CONTENT REQUIRES LAWYER VERIFICATION: I, Only One, son/daughter of [FatherName], holding CNIC No. [Cnic], resident of [Address], do hereby solemnly affirm and declare on oath as under: [AffidavitStatement]
data.interpolatedContentUr: LEGAL CONTENT REQUIRES LAWYER VERIFICATION: میں، Only One، ولد/دختر [FatherName]، شناختی کارڈ نمبر [Cnic]، ساکن [Address]، بحلف اقرار و بیان کرتا/کرتی ہوں کہ: [AffidavitStatement]
validationErrors: Field 'Father / Husband Name' (والد / شوہر کا نام) is required.
Field 'CNIC Number' (قومی شناختی کارڈ نمبر) is required.
Field 'Sworn Statement / Facts' (بیان حلفی کی تفصیل / حقائق) is required.
